visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames, including the final1024x640 summary. Individually authored pale/gray-green striped west marble screen, stepped raking parapet with six open Gothic pinnacles, large central spoke rose/four smaller oculi, tall pointed lights and a recessed central portal under a projecting open protyrus. The long brick church and mapped rounded eastern end have closed red-tile roofs, raised nave/arched clerestory and green-roofed octagonal crossing loggia/lantern. A tall northwest brick campanile has a west clock field, genuinely open belfry, four pediments, dark cap, small lantern and finial. Corrected front/body occlusion, roof-hidden clerestory, a side light behind the campanile, crossing apertures stopping short of the inner wall and floating/inverted distant pinnacle stages. Fine sculpture and glass art remain simplified.
